pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎodào zìjǐ de chuáng shí , xiān zuò le xiàqù .
pairs.english: When Tavi found his bed, the first thing he did was sit down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维找到自己的床时，先坐了下去。

pairs.target: chuángbǎn xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The bed boards creaked.
pairs.hanzi: 床板响了一声。

pairs.target: tā lìjí zhàn qǐ , xiānkāi rù jiǎo chákàn , nài lěi què yǐjīng kào zài ménbiān xiào le .
pairs.english: He immediately stood and lifted a corner of the mattress to inspect it, but Nerai was already laughing against the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 他立即站起，掀开褥角查看，奈蕾却已经靠在门边笑了。

pairs.target: " búshì nǐ zuò huài de . zhèlǐ de chuáng bǐ yǒuxiē lǎoshī niánjì hái dà . "
pairs.english: “You didn't break it by sitting. These beds are older than some of the teachers.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是你坐坏的。这里的床比有些老师年纪还大。”

pairs.target: dēngjì zhīyòng le bànzhǎn chá de gōngfū .
pairs.english: Registration took only half a cup of tea's worth of time.
pairs.hanzi: 登记只用了半盏茶的工夫。

pairs.target: nà zhāng gài guò yìn de zhǐ huànlái chuángwèi pái , fàn pái hé yìzhāng míngzǎo yào dài de kè dān ,
pairs.english: The stamped paper brought him a bed token, a meal token and a class sheet to bring tomorrow morning;
pairs.hanzi: 那张盖过印的纸换来床位牌、饭牌和一张明早要带的课单，

pairs.target: jièyòng de pūgài zé zài láng xià lǐng .
pairs.english: the loaned bedding was collected under the corridor roof.
pairs.hanzi: 借用的铺盖则在廊下领。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi hái huì yǒurén jiào tā děng , bào zhe pūgài zhàn le yíhuìer , cái zhīdào yǐjīng bànwán le .
pairs.english: Expecting someone to tell him to wait again, Tavi stood holding the bedding for a while before realizing it was already done.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为还会有人叫他等，抱着铺盖站了一会儿，才知道已经办完了。

pairs.target: nánshēng zhù de dōng yuàn měijiān sìzhāng chuáng .
pairs.english: In the boys' east courtyard, each room had four beds.
pairs.hanzi: 男生住的东院每间四张床。

pairs.target: tā zhè jiān yǐyǒu liǎngzhāng pù hǎo , qízhōng yìzhāng fàng zhe jiàn zhǎnxīn de lán wàiyī ,
pairs.english: Two beds in his room were already made; on one lay a brand-new blue coat,
pairs.hanzi: 他这间已有两张铺好，其中一张放着件崭新的蓝外衣，

pairs.target: lìng yìzhāng duīmǎn bāofú , dìshàng hái kàozhe yìzhī yìn zhe yán zì de kōng dài .
pairs.english: another was piled with bundles, with an empty sack marked “salt” leaning on the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 另一张堆满包袱，地上还靠着一只印着盐字的空袋。

pairs.target: " lùshang nàge rén ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “The boy from the road?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “路上那个人？”他问。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le yìyǎn kōng dài , yě bùgǎn tì tā rèn .
pairs.english: Nerai glanced at the sack but could not identify its owner for him either.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了一眼空袋，也不敢替他认。

pairs.target: chuāngwài shì xǐyī yuàn , bàn gān de lánbù bèi fēngchuī dé pāpā xiǎng .
pairs.english: Outside the window was the laundry yard, where half-dry blue cloth snapped in the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外是洗衣院，半干的蓝布被风吹得啪啪响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng chuángwèi pái guà zài chuángtóu , hūrán fāxiàn cóng zhèlǐ kànbújiàn huī ào .
pairs.english: Tavi hung the bed token at his bedhead and suddenly realized he could not see Ash Hollow from here.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将床位牌挂在床头，忽然发现从这里看不见灰坳。

pairs.target: shānpō dǎngzhù le xiàmiàn , yě dǎngzhù le tā jīntiān zǒuguò de lù .
pairs.english: The slope hid everything below, including the road he had walked today.
pairs.hanzi: 山坡挡住了下面，也挡住了他今天走过的路。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ kè dān fàngdào chuāng biān , niàn gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: Nerai laid the class sheet by the window and read it to him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把课单放到窗边，念给他听。

pairs.target: míngzǎo dìyīshēng cháng líng hòu , dào xībiān de tīng cái shì ,
pairs.english: Tomorrow morning, after the first long bell, he was to go to the material-listening room in the west,
pairs.hanzi: 明早第一声长铃后，到西边的听材室，

pairs.target: búyòng dài zìjǐ de tiěpiàn , zhǐbǐ yóu jiàoshì fā .
pairs.english: with no need to bring his own iron pieces; paper and pens would be provided in class.
pairs.hanzi: 不用带自己的铁片，纸笔由教室发。

pairs.target: " hòutiān wǎnfàn qián , wǒ zài běi zuōfang děng nǐ . zhǎo búdào , jiù wèn ménkǒu bǔ shuǐlún de rén . "
pairs.english: “I'll wait for you at the north workshop before supper the day after tomorrow. If you can't find it, ask the person repairing the waterwheel by the gate.”
pairs.hanzi: “后天晚饭前，我在北作坊等你。找不到，就问门口补水轮的人。”

pairs.target: " nǐ zhù zhèlǐ ? "
pairs.english: “You're staying here?”
pairs.hanzi: “你住这里？”

pairs.target: " zhè jǐtiān zhù . jīnwǎn xiān qù jiàn gè qiàn wǒ liǎngfēngxìn de rén . "
pairs.english: “For the next few days. Tonight I'm seeing someone who owes me two letters.”
pairs.hanzi: “这几天住。今晚先去见个欠我两封信的人。”

pairs.target: tā tíqǐ xíngnáng , tǎ wéi yě zhàn qǐlái , wàng le gāng tuō xià yìzhī xié .
pairs.english: She lifted her pack; Tavi stood too, forgetting he had just taken off one shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 她提起行囊，塔维也站起来，忘了刚脱下一只鞋。

pairs.target: nài lěi wǎng tā jiǎo shàng kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Nerai glanced at his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾往他脚上看了一眼。

pairs.target: " nǐ yào zhèyàng sòng , wǒ dǎo bùhǎoyìsi zǒu le . "
pairs.english: “If you see me off like that, I'll feel bad leaving.”
pairs.hanzi: “你要这样送，我倒不好意思走了。”

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe zuò huíqù .
pairs.english: He laughed and sat back down.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着坐回去。

pairs.target: děng tā de jiǎobù yuǎn le , wūlǐ zhī shèng lánbù pāidǎ de shēngyīn ,
pairs.english: When her footsteps faded, only the blue cloth's flapping remained in the room;
pairs.hanzi: 等她的脚步远了，屋里只剩蓝布拍打的声音，

pairs.target: gāngcái hái xián chǎo , zhèshí què pàn tā yìzhí xiǎng zhe .
pairs.english: he had just found it noisy, but now hoped it would keep going.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才还嫌吵，这时却盼它一直响着。

pairs.target: tiānhēi qián , tā gēnzhe duānwǎn de rén zhǎodào fàntáng .
pairs.english: Before dark, he followed people carrying bowls to the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 天黑前，他跟着端碗的人找到饭堂。

pairs.target: mén lǐ yìgǔ rèqì , hùn zhe cōng xiāng hé shī mùtou wèi .
pairs.english: Inside was a wave of warmth, smelling of onions and damp wood.
pairs.hanzi: 门里一股热气，混着葱香和湿木头味。

pairs.target: chángzhuō jǐ dé mǎnmǎnde , yǒurén bǎ shū diàn zài wǎn xià ,
pairs.english: The long tables were packed; someone had a book under their bowl,
pairs.hanzi: 长桌挤得满满的，有人把书垫在碗下，

pairs.target: yǒurén yìshǒu chīfàn , yìshǒu hái zài bǐhuà shénme .
pairs.english: someone else ate with one hand while gesturing with the other.
pairs.hanzi: 有人一手吃饭，一手还在比画什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lǐngdào dòu fàn hé yìsháo dùncài , zhàn zài guò dào lǐ ,
pairs.english: Tavi collected rice with beans and a ladle of stew and stood in the aisle,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维领到豆饭和一勺炖菜，站在过道里，

pairs.target: juéde měizhāng kōng dèng dōu xiàng yǒurén zànshí líkāi .
pairs.english: feeling that every empty stool belonged to someone who had only stepped away.
pairs.hanzi: 觉得每张空凳都像有人暂时离开。

pairs.target: " zhèér méi rén . "
pairs.english: “Nobody's here.”
pairs.hanzi: “这儿没人。”

pairs.target: kàochuāng de nǚhái bǎ dèng shàng de mùhé nuó dào jiǎo biān , zìjǐ què méiyǒu wǎng pángbiān suō .
pairs.english: The girl by the window moved a wooden box from the stool to her feet without moving over herself.
pairs.hanzi: 靠窗的女孩把凳上的木盒挪到脚边，自己却没有往旁边缩。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐhǎo cè zhe shēn zuòxià .
pairs.english: Tavi had to sit sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维只好侧着身坐下。

pairs.target: " nǐ dǎng zhe yán le . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “You're blocking the salt,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “你挡着盐了。”她说。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn zài nuó , tā shēnshǒu yuèguò tā , jiāng yánguàn tuī dào zhuōzi zhōngjiān .
pairs.english: He hastily shifted again; she reached past him and pushed the salt pot to the middle of the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧再挪，她伸手越过他，将盐罐推到桌子中间。

pairs.target: " búshì jiào nǐ zǒu . "
pairs.english: “I wasn't telling you to leave.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是叫你走。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu jìxù chī . tǎ wéi yě chī le yìkǒu ,
pairs.english: She looked down and went on eating. Tavi took a bite too,
pairs.hanzi: 她低头继续吃。塔维也吃了一口，

pairs.target: cái fāxiàn cài lǐ yǒu yìzhǒng cuì cuì de gēn , jiáo xiàqù dài tián .
pairs.english: discovering a crisp root in the stew that tasted sweet when chewed.
pairs.hanzi: 才发现菜里有一种脆脆的根，嚼下去带甜。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào míngzì , yòu jiá yíkuài zǐxì kàn .
pairs.english: He did not know its name and picked up another piece to look closely.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道名字，又夹一块仔细看。

pairs.target: " bié tiāo nàge . " nǚhái shuō .
pairs.english: “Don't pick that one,” the girl said.
pairs.hanzi: “别挑那个。”女孩说。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi yǒu shénme guījǔ , lìkè fàngxià .
pairs.english: Thinking there was some rule, he put it down at once.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为有什么规矩，立刻放下。

pairs.target: " wǒ xǐhuan chī . nǐ bùchī jiù gěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “I like it. Give it to me if you aren't eating it.”
pairs.hanzi: “我喜欢吃。你不吃就给我。”

pairs.target: tā wàng zhe tā , tā zhōngyú rěnbúzhù xiào ,
pairs.english: He stared at her, and she finally broke into laughter,
pairs.hanzi: 他望着她，她终于忍不住笑，

pairs.target: jiázǒu yìxiǎokuài , yòu jiāng zìjǐ wǎn lǐ de yíkuài dìguòlái .
pairs.english: taking a small piece and offering one from her own bowl in return.
pairs.hanzi: 夹走一小块，又将自己碗里的一块递过来。

pairs.target: " huàn nǐ de . zhège méi nàme lǎo . "
pairs.english: “A trade. This one's less fibrous.”
pairs.hanzi: “换你的。这个没那么老。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cháng le , guǒrán nèn yìxiē .
pairs.english: Tavi tasted it; it was indeed more tender.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维尝了，果然嫩一些。

pairs.target: " tǎ wéi . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Tavi,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “塔维。”他说。

pairs.target: " mǐlā . "
pairs.english: “Mira.”
pairs.hanzi: “米拉。”

pairs.target: tā de xiùkǒu juàn dé hěn gāo , shǒuwàn shàng yǒu yídào méi cājìng de mò ,
pairs.english: Her sleeves were rolled high, with a streak of ink still on her wrist,
pairs.hanzi: 她的袖口卷得很高，手腕上有一道没擦净的墨，

pairs.target: mùhé kāi zhe yídào fèng , lǐmiàn de chǐ hé yuánguī gè yǒu zìjǐ de cáo .
pairs.english: and through a gap in the box he could see a ruler and compasses, each in its own groove.
pairs.hanzi: 木盒开着一道缝，里面的尺和圆规各有自己的槽。

pairs.target: hégài shàng què zhān zhe fànlì .
pairs.english: Yet grains of rice stuck to the lid.
pairs.hanzi: 盒盖上却沾着饭粒。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn le , yòng zhǐtou bō diào , suíshǒu cèng zài zhuōxià .
pairs.english: She noticed, flicked them off, and casually wiped her finger under the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见了，用指头拨掉，随手蹭在桌下。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě shì jīntiān dào ? "
pairs.english: “Did you arrive today too?”
pairs.hanzi: “你也是今天到？”

pairs.target: " zuótiān . wǒ yǐjīng zǒu cuò sānhuí lóu le . yào wènlù , zhǎo biérén . "
pairs.english: “Yesterday. I've already gone to the wrong building three times. Ask someone else for directions.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天。我已经走错三回楼了。要问路，找别人。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngzài xiǎng gāi jiē shénme huà , tóudǐng de dēng hūrán liàng le yì jié .
pairs.english: As Tavi wondered what to say next, the lamps overhead suddenly brightened.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正在想该接什么话，头顶的灯忽然亮了一截。

pairs.target: búshì tiān le yóu .
pairs.english: No oil had been added.
pairs.hanzi: 不是添了油。

pairs.target: qiángbiān yǒu gè chuān wéiqún de rén bān xià tóng bǐng ,
pairs.english: Someone in an apron pulled a brass handle by the wall,
pairs.hanzi: 墙边有个穿围裙的人扳下铜柄，

pairs.target: zhěngpái rǔbái dēngzhào yìzhǎn jiē yìzhǎn fànchū róuguāng , lián yuǎnchù liáng shàng de jiù mùwén dōu kàndéqīng .
pairs.english: The whole row of milky shades glowed softly one after another, revealing even the old wood grain on the distant beams.
pairs.hanzi: 整排乳白灯罩一盏接一盏泛出柔光，连远处梁上的旧木纹都看得清。

pairs.target: méiyǒu yān , yě méiyǒu huǒmiáo wǎng shàng cuān .
pairs.english: There was no smoke, nor any flame leaping upward.
pairs.hanzi: 没有烟，也没有火苗往上蹿。

pairs.target: tā tái zhe tóu , sháozǐ tíng zài bànkōng .
pairs.english: He stared up, his spoon halted in midair.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬着头，勺子停在半空。

pairs.target: mǐlā shùnzhe kàn qù , zuǐlǐ hái jiáo zhe cài .
pairs.english: Mira followed his gaze, still chewing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉顺着看去，嘴里还嚼着菜。

pairs.target: " nǐjiā méi zhèzhǒng ? "
pairs.english: “Your family doesn't have these?”
pairs.hanzi: “你家没这种？”

pairs.target: tā yáotóu .
pairs.english: He shook his head.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头。

pairs.target: " wǒjiā yě méiyǒu . lù suǒ cái yǒu . wǒ diē shuō huài yícì , xiū dēng de qián gòumǎi bànnián dēngyóu . "
pairs.english: “Neither does mine. Only the road office does. My father says one repair costs half a year's lamp oil.”
pairs.hanzi: “我家也没有。路所才有。我爹说坏一次，修灯的钱够买半年灯油。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ sháozǐ fàngxià , zhàn qǐlái xiǎng kàn dēngzhào hòumiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi put down his spoon and stood to look behind the shade.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把勺子放下，站起来想看灯罩后面。

pairs.target: dēng guà dé tài gāo , zhǐnéng kànjiàn liǎnggēn xìguǎn tōng jìn qiáng lǐ .
pairs.english: It hung too high; all he could see were two thin tubes running into the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 灯挂得太高，只能看见两根细管通进墙里。

pairs.target: tā rào dào zhùzi lìngyìbiān , mǐlā yě gēn guòlái , wǎn hái ná zhe .
pairs.english: He went around the pillar, and Mira followed, still holding her bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 他绕到柱子另一边，米拉也跟过来，碗还拿着。

pairs.target: " wǒ zuótiān yě méi kàn míngbái . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I couldn't work it out yesterday either,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “我昨天也没看明白。”她说。

pairs.target: guǎn shàng yǒu yìxiǎokuài tóng gài , biānyuán mó dé fāliàng .
pairs.english: A small brass cover on the tube had edges worn bright.
pairs.hanzi: 管上有一小块铜盖，边缘磨得发亮。

pairs.target: tāmen zhèng còujìn , yìzhī chángbǐng sháo cóng liǎng rén zhījiān shēnguòqù , qiāo le qiāo kōngtǒng .
pairs.english: As they leaned closer, a long-handled ladle reached between them and tapped an empty bucket.
pairs.hanzi: 他们正凑近，一只长柄勺从两人之间伸过去，敲了敲空桶。

pairs.target: " yánjiū wán le , bǎ shèngfàn dǎo zhèér . bié dǎo zài wǒ jiǎo biān . "
pairs.english: “When you've finished studying, put the leftovers here. Not by my feet.”
pairs.hanzi: “研究完了，把剩饭倒这儿。别倒在我脚边。”

pairs.target: mǐlā gǎnjǐn shōuhuí wǎn . tǎ wéi dītóu , cái fāxiànzìjǐ zhèng zhàn zài shōu wǎn de rén yào zǒu de lùshang .
pairs.english: Mira hastily drew her bowl back. Tavi looked down and realized he was blocking the bowl collector's path.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉赶紧收回碗。塔维低头，才发现自己正站在收碗的人要走的路上。

pairs.target: huí zhuōbiān yǐhòu , mǐlā shuō tā yào qù zhǎo rèshuǐ , tíqǐ mùhé jiù zǒu .
pairs.english: Back at the table, Mira said she was going to find hot water, picked up her box and left.
pairs.hanzi: 回桌边以后，米拉说她要去找热水，提起木盒就走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiàozhù tā , wèn gāngcái nàzhǒng gēn jiào shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi called her back to ask the name of the root.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维叫住她，问刚才那种根叫什么。

pairs.target: " tián wú gēn . nǐ búshì yǐjīng chī le sānkuài ? "
pairs.english: “Sweet turnip. Haven't you eaten three pieces already?”
pairs.hanzi: “甜芜根。你不是已经吃了三块？”

pairs.target: " wǒ dé xiěxìn . "
pairs.english: “I need to write a letter.”
pairs.hanzi: “我得写信。”

pairs.target: tā kàn tā yìyǎn , méiyǒu zài xiào tā ,
pairs.english: She glanced at him without teasing him again,
pairs.hanzi: 她看他一眼，没有再笑他，

pairs.target: cóng hézi lǐ chōuchū yì jié duǎn qiānbǐ , zài tā de kè dān bèimiàn xiě le sāngè zì .
pairs.english: took a short pencil from her box and wrote the three characters on the back of his class sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 从盒子里抽出一截短铅笔，在他的课单背面写了三个字。

pairs.target: nàtiān wǎnshàng , wūlǐ lìngwài sāngè rén lùxù huílái .
pairs.english: That evening the other three occupants returned one after another.
pairs.hanzi: 那天晚上，屋里另外三个人陆续回来。

pairs.target: dài yán dài de guǒrán shì lùshang de nánhái , tā fùqīn zǎo zǒu le ;
pairs.english: The one with the salt sack was indeed the boy from the road; his father had already left.
pairs.hanzi: 带盐袋的果然是路上的男孩，他父亲早走了；

pairs.target: nánhái bǎ kōng dài sāi dào chuángdǐ , shuō tā niáng xián yán dài zhā rén , tā diē què zhī zhǎo dédào zhège .
pairs.english: The boy pushed the empty sack under the bed, saying his mother found salt sacks scratchy, but this was all his father could find.
pairs.hanzi: 男孩把空袋塞到床底，说他娘嫌盐袋扎人，他爹却只找得到这个。

pairs.target: dàjiā máng zhe pūchuáng , zhǎoshuǐ , méi rén wèn tǎ wéi wèishénme zǒng kàn chuāngwài .
pairs.english: Everyone was busy making beds and fetching water; nobody asked why Tavi kept looking out the window.
pairs.hanzi: 大家忙着铺床、找水，没人问塔维为什么总看窗外。

pairs.target: tā jiè dào yìdiǎn mò , zài chuāng biān xiě le sānháng xìn .
pairs.english: He borrowed a little ink and wrote three lines of a letter by the window.
pairs.hanzi: 他借到一点墨，在窗边写了三行信。

pairs.target: dìyīháng shuō dào le , dìèrháng shuō fàn lǐ yǒu tián wú gēn , dìsānháng xiě dēng bú màoyān .
pairs.english: The first said he had arrived, the second that dinner included sweet turnip, the third that the lamps did not smoke.
pairs.hanzi: 第一行说到了，第二行说饭里有甜芜根，第三行写灯不冒烟。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tiān le yíjù : zhèlǐ tài dà , jīntiān hái bú rènlù .
pairs.english: Finally he added: this place is so big, I still don't know my way around today.
pairs.hanzi: 最后添了一句：这里太大，今天还不认路。

pairs.target: zì wāi dé xiàng wǎng shānxià zǒu . tā bǎ zhǐ bǎizhèng , yòu kàn le yíbiàn , děng mò gān .
pairs.english: The crooked words looked as though they were heading downhill. He straightened the paper, read it again, and waited for the ink to dry.
pairs.hanzi: 字歪得像往山下走。他把纸摆正，又看了一遍，等墨干。

pairs.target: duì chuáng yǒurén wèn néng bunéng chuīdēng .
pairs.english: Someone across the room asked if they could blow out the lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 对床有人问能不能吹灯。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děng yìxiǎo huìer , suíhòu fāxiànzìjǐ qíshí yǐjīng kùn dé kànbùqīng zuìhòu nàge zì .
pairs.english: Tavi asked for a moment, then realized he was already too sleepy to make out the last character.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说等一小会儿，随后发现自己其实已经困得看不清最后那个字。
